config.script:
selected_data = self.props.selection.active.data
   	if len(selected_data) ==1:
   		alarm_source = selected_data[0].source
   	equipment_name = alarm_source.split('/')[2]
   	navPath = system.db.runPrepQuery(
		"SELECT NavPath FROM alarmNav WHERE AlarmSource = ?",
		[str(equipment_name)]
	)
	self.parent.parent.getChild("Label_0").props.text=equipment_name
	navPath=navPath[0]['NavPath']
	
	if navPath:
		system.perspective.navigate(view=str(navPath),params={"equipmentName":equipment_name})
	else:
		system.perspective.print("No navigation mapping found for source: " + equipment_name)

extensionFunctions.script:
activeTime = system.date.fromMillis(
        alarmEvent.getActiveData().getTimestamp()
    )

    duration = system.date.secondsBetween(
        activeTime,
        system.date.now()
    )

    system.perspective.print(
        alarmEvent.getName() + " : " + str(duration)
    )

    return True
